analysis: Proposal revision and resolver invalidation v1
interpretation: The refreshed materialized resolver tracks a controlled series of proposal additions, tie creation/removal, and score mutation by rewriting derived values, including false and empty sentinels. These observations are checked against an independent score oracle.
limits: One controlled proposal family and four sizes.
The empty string is a chosen selection sentinel; no general truth-maintenance or deletion semantics are implied.
No concurrency, learned proposal generation, or asymptotic guarantee is measured.
